title: The dashboard page loads its fonts from Google on every open while the API serves it with the Content-Security-Policy turned off, so a third party learns when and from where the operator opens the bot dashboard, and the browser has no limit on which origins the page may load from

evidence.note: the built dashboard (dashboard/dist) is served by the bot process itself
both font stacks have local fallbacks, so the external fonts are not needed

sibling_sites_checked: Every external URL in the dashboard sources (grep for http:// and https:// over the snapshot): index.html:7 only (the AntiRugExitDetailModal explorer link is a prop that is never passed). XSS paths: no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, eval or new Function anywhere in dashboard/src; token addresses, alert text and symbols are rendered as React text (EventFeed.tsx:100, PositionTable.tsx:160), so no injection was found; the API key is typed into a password field, sent once (LoginForm.tsx:18-23) and never stored (no localStorage, sessionStorage or document.cookie use except sidebar and gap-banner flags). The CORS / Host checks are AUD-API-005 and the cookie flags AUD-API-007.
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: a privacy leak of operator activity and a missing defence-in-depth layer; no injection path was found that the missing CSP would have stopped.
recommendation: Serve the fonts from the dashboard build (or use the local fallbacks) and enable a strict CSP (default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' plus the ws origin). Phase 29, together with card API-03.
